name: Issue 753: Frostburn removes the cast time of Glacial Rune and Permafrost Rune
contract: Frostburn 705594 (passive) reads 'Removes the cast time of Glacial Rune and Permafrost Rune.' Effect 1 is a
native percent modifier (aura 108) of SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME (10), BasePoints -101 (-100%), on family 38 mask1
0x4200000, which Glacial Rune 807842 (mask1 0x200000, 1250 ms cast) and Permafrost Rune 804060 (mask1 0x4000000,
1000 ms cast) carry. Effect 0 is a copied override-script selector 20001 (critical damage versus Frozen targets)
with an amount of 0 that the description does not mention. Expected: both runes keep their cast times without
the talent, become instant with it, and regain them when it is removed; a real Glacial Rune cast shows a cast
bar without Frostburn and places its rune at once with it. This is evidence that the mechanic already works.

steps.label: Glacial Rune has a cast time without Frostburn
Permafrost Rune has a cast time without Frostburn
Without Frostburn Glacial Rune shows a cast bar
SETUP: the cast completes and places the rune
With Frostburn Glacial Rune has no cast bar
With Frostburn the rune is placed at once
Removing Frostburn restores Glacial Rune's cast time
Removing Frostburn restores Permafrost Rune's cast time
